steps.title: Cru reports back
steps.body: Chats Cru sets going, and any you ask it to follow, are reported on when they finish or need you: said aloud where a voice screen is open, by the PC app if it is running, and as a notification on the phone. Only then, never at every step.

keys: Keep an eye on the API chat
keys.text: every turn, until you say stop

steps.title: Tell Cru you're done
steps.body: Say "that's all" or "goodbye" and Cru says a quick goodbye and closes its own screen.
